checks.name: preserves_rows
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from migration import migrate
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); db.execute('CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL)'); db.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES(1,'Ada')"); migrate(db)
assert db.execute('SELECT id,name,email FROM users').fetchall()==[(1,'Ada',None)]

checks.name: idempotent
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from migration import migrate
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); migrate(db); db.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES(1,'Ada','ada@example.test')"); migrate(db)
assert db.execute('SELECT * FROM users').fetchall()==[(1,'Ada','ada@example.test')] and db.execute('PRAGMA user_version').fetchone()==(2,)

checks.name: malformed_schema_rejected
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from migration import migrate
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); db.execute('CREATE TABLE users(wrong TEXT)'); db.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES('keep')")
try: migrate(db)
except (ValueError,sqlite3.DatabaseError): pass
else: raise AssertionError('malformed schema replaced')
assert db.execute('SELECT wrong FROM users').fetchall()==[('keep',)]
